name: Dracula 4: The Shadow of the Dragon

locations.note: Ellen Cross learns in her New York apartment that the Vambery collection went down with its freighter, and at the end opens the case from Istanbul there to find a portrait of Adam Stoker that comes to life.
Ellen confirms the auctioned painting is from the Vambery collection, but the thief Adrian Friedlen dies in terror in his police cell before she can question him.
At Professor Vambery's manor Ellen meets Adam Stoker and finds a bust of Vlad Tepes and a vampire hunter's kit hidden in the family tomb.
Ellen breaks into the painter Yanek's home and finds two lost Vambery paintings, a body in the attic and a sealed case.
Museum director Phillips sends Ellen, a restorer at the Met, to Budapest to check whether one of the lost Vambery paintings has resurfaced.

routes.name: Ellen Cross
routes.note: Ellen's hunt for the lost Vambery paintings from New York to Budapest, Whitby and Istanbul and back home.
